summary: Nubes (Latin for "cloud") is the cloud-mate Hyginus names alongside Ixion as parent of centaurs such as Nessus and Eurytion. She belongs to the Ixion-centaur genealogy and must be distinguished from Nephele, the cloud of Athamas.

sections.heading: Mythology
paragraphs: Hyginus gives Nessus and other centaurs the parentage Ixion and Nubes. Apollodorus instead has Zeus' cloud in Hera's likeness bear Centaurus after Ixion's attempt on Hera.
